   "id": "456c55d3",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# 3. Describe your own detector\n",
    "\n",
    "A CMS chamber comes from the XML; anything else is written as a spec. There are\n",
    "three levels of verbosity for the same document, and this notebook uses all\n",
    "three:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. the short constructors `make_layer`, `make_superlayer`, `make_station`;\n",
    "2. the plain dataclasses (`StationSpec`, `SuperLayerSpec`, `LayerSpec`, ...);\n",
    "3. a JSON file, which is what you keep in the repository.\n",
    "\n",
    "The example is a test-beam chamber: two super layers, four layers each, 20 cm\n",
    "pitch, the second super layer turned by 90 degrees like a CMS middle one."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "id": "f78dc77a",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.102123Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.101662Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.916195Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.912845Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "TB-1 [1, 2] G4_AIR\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline\n",
    "from mpldts.geometry.constructors import make_layer, make_station, make_superlayer\n",
    "from mpldts.geometry.specs import Box, CellGrid, Pose\n",
    "\n",
    "PITCH = 20.0\n",
    "\n",
    "def layers():\n",
    "    return [\n",
    "        make_layer(number,\n",
    "                   CellGrid(pitch=PITCH, count=8, shape=Box(PITCH, 100.0, 1.3),\n",
    "                            material=\"GasMixture\"),\n",
    "                   pose=Pose.translated(0.0, 0.0, (number - 2.5) * 2.0))\n",
    "        for number in range(1, 5)\n",
    "    ]\n",
    "\n",
    "super_layers = [\n",
    "    make_superlayer(number, layers(),\n",
    "                    pose=Pose.rotated_z(90.0 if number == 2 else 0.0,\n",
    "                                        (0.0, 0.0, (number - 1.5) * 9.5)))\n",
    "    for number in (1, 2)\n",
    "]\n",
    "chamber = make_station(\"TB-1\", super_layers, shape=Box(8 * PITCH, 100.0, 9.5 + 8.8))\n",
    "print(chamber.name, [sl.number for sl in chamber.super_layers], chamber.material)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5a448c04",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## From a station to a detector\n",
    "\n",
    "`DetectorSpec` groups stations, gives them a pose and can hold structural solids\n",
    "(the yoke, the table) that are data only - they are never turned into nodes."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "e639914b",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.919841Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.919498Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.936018Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.933284Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "stations: ['TB-1', 'TB-2']\n",
      "structure is data, not a node: True\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from mpldts.geometry import Station, build_detector\n",
    "from mpldts.geometry.specs import DetectorSpec, StructureSpec, validate\n",
    "\n",
    "detector = DetectorSpec(\n",
    "    name=\"test beam\",\n",
    "    pose=Pose.identity(),\n",
    "    stations=[\n",
    "        make_station(\"TB-1\", super_layers, shape=chamber.shape,\n",
    "                     pose=Pose.translated(-40.0, 0.0, 0.0)),\n",
    "        make_station(\"TB-2\", super_layers, shape=chamber.shape,\n",
    "                     pose=Pose.rotated_z(90.0, (40.0, 0.0, 0.0))),\n",
    "    ],\n",
    "    structure=[StructureSpec(\"Table\", Pose.translated(0.0, 0.0, -80.0),\n",
    "                             Box(200.0, 200.0, 10.0))],\n",
    ")\n",
    "validate(detector)\n",
    "node = build_detector(detector)\n",
    "print(\"stations:\", [child.name for child in node.children])\n",
    "print(\"structure is data, not a node:\", \"Table\" not in [child.name for child in node.children])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "a172b7f3",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.941275Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:19.940815Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:20.274227Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:20.272175Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1300x400 with 2 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from mpldts.patches import DTStationPatch\n",
    "\n",
    "figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 4))\n",
    "for axis, spec in zip(axes, detector.stations):\n",
    "    station = Station.from_spec(spec)\n",
    "    width, height, length = station.bounds\n",
    "    x, y, z = station.local_center\n",
    "    DTStationPatch(station, axis, faceview=\"phi\", local=True)\n",
    "    axis.set_xlim(x - width / 2 - 5, x + width / 2 + 5)\n",
    "    axis.set_ylim(z - height / 2 - 5, z + height / 2 + 5)\n",
    "    axis.set_title(\"%s, drawn in its own frame\" % station.name)\n",
    "    axis.set_xlabel(\"x [cm]\")\n",
    "    axis.set_ylabel(\"z [cm]\")\n",
    "figure.tight_layout()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "aa01cac8",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Keep it as a JSON document\n",
    "\n",
    "A spec serialises to a document that validates on the way back in, so the\n",
    "geometry of a custom detector can live in the repository next to the code."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "586fbe28",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:20.278092Z",

     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:20.286731Z"
    }
   },

     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [

      "  \"pose\": {\n",
      "    \"rotation\": [\n",
      "      [\n",
      "        1.0,\n",
      "        0.0,\n",
      "        0.0\n",
      "      ],\n",
      "      [\n",

      "      ],\n",

      "          [\n",
      "        \n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import json\n",
    "from mpldts.geometry.serialize import from_json, to_json\n",
    "\n",
    "text = to_json(detector)\n",
    "restored = from_json(text)\n",
    "print(len(text), \"bytes of JSON;\", len(restored.stations), \"stations back\")\n",
    "print(json.dumps(json.loads(text)[\"stations\"][0], indent=2)[:500])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "8cc33dda",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Export it for Geant4\n",
    "\n",
    "`iter_volume_placements` walks the node tree and `TgSink` writes the `.tg` text\n",
    "that the Geant4 simulation reads with `G4tgbVolumeMgr`. One solid per station,\n",
    "one placement per cell."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "402ffb09",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-11-10T00:59:20.293638Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-11-10T00:59:20.292846Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-11-10T00:59:20.323192Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-11-10T00:59:20.320737Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "130 placements\n",
      "// mplDTs .tg export: test_beam\n",
      "\n",
      ":SOLID Solid_TB-1 BOX 80.000000*cm 50.000000*cm 9.150000*cm\n",
      ":VOLU TB-1 Solid_TB-1 G4_AIR\n",
      "\n",
      ":PLACE TB-1 1 world R0 -40.000000*cm 0.000000*cm 0.000000*cm\n",
      ":SOLID Solid_DriftCell_TB-1_SL1 BOX 10.000000*cm 50.000000*cm 0.650000*cm\n",
      ":VOLU DriftCell_TB-1_SL1 Solid_DriftCell_TB-1_SL1 GasMixture\n",
      "\n",
      ":PLACE DriftCell_TB-1_SL1 1 TB-1 R0 -70.000000*cm 0.000000*cm -7.750000*cm\n",
      ":PLACE DriftCell_TB-1_SL1 2 TB-1 R0 -50.000000*cm 0.000000*cm -7.750000*cm\n",
      ":PLACE DriftCell_TB-1_SL1 3 TB-1 R0 -30.000000*cm 0.000000*cm -7.750000*cm\n",
      ":PLACE DriftCell_TB-1_SL1 4 TB-1 R0 -10.000000*cm 0.000\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "from mpldts.export import TgSink, export_volumes, iter_volume_placements\n",
    "\n",
    "print(len(list(iter_volume_placements(node))), \"placements\")\n",
    "\n",
    "import io\n",
    "stream = io.StringIO()\n",
    "export_volumes(node, TgSink(stream))\n",
    "print(stream.getvalue()[:600])"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "48b727f2",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "The volume names in that block are a contract: the C++ `StationSD` parses the\n",
    "wheel out of `MB0_W-2_SE1_ST1`, which is why the minus sign survives the\n",
    "sanitiser. Do not rename them without reading the naming page.\n",
    "\n",
    "What next:\n",
    "\n",
    "- `docs/concepts/model.rst` - why specs, nodes and views are separate;\n",
    "- `docs/howto/geant4.rst` - how the `.tg` file is consumed;\n",
    "- `docs/about/roadmap.rst` - the GDML backend is an idea, not a feature yet."
   ]
  }
